get.description:
Get a list of Contacts Fields in the Joomla site.

The route selects the context for reading. When creating a field or field group, also send context matching the route: it is not applied when saving. Without context the record can be saved but the response is 404. A field also needs description and non-empty params; a group needs description. Field names must be unique across contexts. Do not reuse a definition ID in another context. The field plugin determines value shape and fieldparams. A text field takes a string; a subform has rows whose complete structure must be preserved. A partial recursive merge of subform rows is not guaranteed. The contracts include parameter forms for core field plugins. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.
